title: MinecraftUpdated
body:
- **This Modpack makes Minecraft's athmosphere: Better, Pleasant And Enjoyable.**
- _**MinecraftUpdated doesn't add any new Entity.**_
# ModPack Details:
### Main Changes:
> This ModPack adds lot more things this is mainly what it changes:
- MinecraftMenus
- Animations
- Textures
- Sounds
### Performance:
- **MinecraftUpdated** has low impact on Performance. Help of Performance mods such as **Sodium**, **Nvidium**, **Lithium**, **Ksyxis** Etc. Overall makes ModPack **LightWeight And Playable.** Also new version Of Minecraft especially on MC 1.21 chunk loading is complicated and needs good CPU.
### Optifine: ~~_**Don't Use**_~~
- We can't install **Optifine** on **Fabric** Loader it only works on **Forge**. Also mod Sodium And Optifine **Do Not Match Each Other And Causes Problems**, because this two mods have Different **Rendering Engines**.
### ServerSide: ~~_not recommended_~~
- **MinecraftUpdated** isn't ~~ServerSide~~ ModPack for now **But u Can Play With Your Friends On Lan Server.**
